catalog.name: Stratum SaaS Finance Metric Catalog
catalog.source_dataset: Prime Levels synthetic B2B SaaS subscription dataset
catalog.purpose: Single source of truth for finance metric definitions used by the Executive Dashboard, AI Finance Copilot, and automated Monthly Business Review.

verified_structure.subscription_months_grain: one row per customer_id per period_month

governance.finance_first_rule: If a number matters, calculate it deterministically in SQL or Python. Use the LLM to route, interpret, summarize, and explain - not as the calculator of record.
governance.primary_fact_rule: Use subscription_months as the historical recurring-revenue fact table. Do not use subscriptions.mrr_usd as the historical time series.
governance.customer_grain_rule: The supplied subscription_months file is verified as one row per customer_id per period_month. Use customer_id as the account/logo grain for retention and concentration metrics.
governance.period_rule: Every answer and visual must state the exact as-of date or date range used.
governance.dimension_rule: Join subscription_months.customer_id to customers.customer_id and subscription_months.plan_id to plans.plan_id for segmentation.
governance.billing_rule: Use invoices.subtotal_usd for net invoice value before tax. Do not confuse invoice-date billings with point-in-time ARR.

ambiguity_rules.behavior: In this portfolio, map this alias to avg_ttm_arr and label the answer 'Average ARR - TTM'. Explain on request that standard ARR is point-in-time.
Clarify whether the user means ARR/MRR, recognized subscription revenue, or invoice-date billings. Do not silently substitute one for another.
Distinguish Churned MRR from Logo Churn unless context makes the requested measure explicit.
Interpret as the latest fully loaded period_month (2026-06) unless a different date is supplied.

ending_mrr.label: Ending MRR
ending_mrr.definition: Point-in-time monthly recurring run rate at the selected month end.
ending_mrr.caveat: MRR is a recurring run-rate metric. In this synthetic dataset the monthly ledger also reconciles to subscription revenue, but keep the MRR label for this KPI.
validation_tests: company MRR equals the sum of customer-month mrr_usd

current_arr.label: Current ARR
current_arr.definition: Annualized point-in-time recurring run rate at the selected month end.
current_arr.caveat: This is the standard point-in-time ARR metric.

avg_ttm_arr.label: Average ARR - TTM
avg_ttm_arr.definition: Average of the 12 month-end ARR observations ending in the selected month.
avg_ttm_arr.formula: AVG(12 * monthly SUM(subscription_months.mrr_usd)) across selected period and prior 11 period_months
avg_ttm_arr.caveat: This is a portfolio-specific management metric, not the standard SaaS definition of ARR. The Copilot may accept 'TTM ARR' as an alias, but should label the output 'Average ARR - TTM'.

arr_yoy_growth_pct.label: ARR Growth YoY
arr_yoy_growth_pct.definition: Percentage change in Current ARR versus the same month 12 months earlier.
arr_yoy_growth_pct.caveat: Requires a comparable month 12 months earlier.
validation_tests: null when 12-month prior comparator is unavailable

new_mrr.label: New MRR
new_mrr.definition: Recurring revenue added during the selected month for rows classified as New by subscription_months.movement_type.
new_mrr.caveat: Uses the source movement classification directly.

expansion_mrr.label: Expansion MRR
expansion_mrr.definition: Recurring revenue added during the selected month for rows classified as Expansion by subscription_months.movement_type.
expansion_mrr.caveat: Uses the source movement classification directly.

reactivation_mrr.label: Reactivation MRR
reactivation_mrr.definition: Recurring revenue added during the selected month for rows classified as Reactivation by subscription_months.movement_type.
reactivation_mrr.caveat: Uses the source movement classification directly.

contraction_mrr.label: Contraction MRR
contraction_mrr.definition: Recurring revenue lost during the selected month for rows classified as Contraction by subscription_months.movement_type.
contraction_mrr.caveat: Displayed as a positive loss amount; raw mrr_delta_usd is negative.

churned_mrr.label: Churned MRR
churned_mrr.definition: Recurring revenue lost during the selected month for rows classified as Churn by subscription_months.movement_type.
churned_mrr.caveat: Displayed as a positive loss amount; raw mrr_delta_usd is negative.

active_customers.label: Active Customers
active_customers.definition: Distinct customer accounts with positive MRR at the selected month end.
active_customers.caveat: The supplied ledger is verified as one row per customer per period_month, so customer counts do not double count subscriptions.

avg_mrr_per_account.label: Average MRR per Active Account
avg_mrr_per_account.definition: Ending MRR divided by active customer accounts at the selected month end.
avg_mrr_per_account.caveat: ARPA-style recurring-revenue metric; not average invoice value.

avg_arr_per_account.label: Average ARR per Active Account
avg_arr_per_account.definition: Current ARR divided by active customer accounts at the selected month end.
avg_arr_per_account.caveat: Annualized recurring run rate per active account.

nrr_12m.label: Net Revenue Retention - 12M
nrr_12m.definition: Ending MRR from the accounts active 12 months earlier divided by those accounts' beginning MRR; new accounts after the beginning date are excluded.
nrr_12m.formula: For beginning cohort where mrr_usd > 0 at period T-12: SUM(mrr_usd at T, default 0 if absent) / SUM(mrr_usd at T-12)
nrr_12m.caveat: Can exceed 100% because expansion among the beginning cohort is included.

grr_12m.label: Gross Revenue Retention - 12M
grr_12m.definition: Recurring revenue retained after 12 months from the beginning account cohort, excluding expansion.
grr_12m.formula: SUM(MIN(end_mrr, begin_mrr) by beginning customer_id) / SUM(begin_mrr)
grr_12m.caveat: Capped at 100% by construction; expansion is excluded.

logo_retention_12m.label: Logo Retention - 12M
logo_retention_12m.definition: Share of accounts active 12 months earlier that still have positive MRR at the selected month end.
logo_retention_12m.formula: COUNT(beginning customer_id with end_mrr > 0) / COUNT(beginning active customer_id)
logo_retention_12m.caveat: Account-count retention; customers are not weighted by ARR.

logo_churn_12m.label: Logo Churn - 12M
logo_churn_12m.definition: Share of accounts active 12 months earlier that no longer have positive MRR at the selected month end.
logo_churn_12m.caveat: Customer-count churn; distinct from Churned MRR.

top_5_arr_concentration.label: Top 5 ARR Concentration
top_5_arr_concentration.definition: Share of Current ARR attributable to the 5 largest customer accounts at the selected month end.
top_5_arr_concentration.caveat: Customer/account grain is used before ranking.

top_10_arr_concentration.label: Top 10 ARR Concentration
top_10_arr_concentration.definition: Share of Current ARR attributable to the 10 largest customer accounts at the selected month end.
top_10_arr_concentration.caveat: Customer/account grain is used before ranking.

top_20_arr_concentration.label: Top 20 ARR Concentration
top_20_arr_concentration.definition: Share of Current ARR attributable to the 20 largest customer accounts at the selected month end.
top_20_arr_concentration.caveat: Customer/account grain is used before ranking.

monthly_billings.label: Monthly Billings / Net Invoice Value
monthly_billings.definition: Net invoice value issued in the selected invoice month before tax.
monthly_billings.caveat: Uses subtotal_usd (amount_usd less discount_usd, before tax). This is invoice-date billings and can be lumpy for annual/multi-month invoices. Refund/failed/overdue policy can be added as separate collection metrics.

active_customers_yoy_pct.label: Active Customer Growth YoY
active_customers_yoy_pct.definition: Percentage change in active customer accounts versus the same month 12 months earlier.
active_customers_yoy_pct.caveat: Requires a comparable month 12 months earlier and uses active accounts with positive MRR.
validation_tests: null when 12-month prior comparator is unavailable

avg_arr_per_account_yoy_pct.label: Average ARR per Active Account Growth YoY
avg_arr_per_account_yoy_pct.definition: Percentage change in Average ARR per Active Account versus the same month 12 months earlier.
avg_arr_per_account_yoy_pct.caveat: Annualized recurring run rate per active account; requires a comparable month 12 months earlier.
validation_tests: null when 12-month prior comparator is unavailable

validation_checks.rule: subscription_months has exactly one row per customer_id + period_month
subscription_months customer/subscription/plan keys and invoice customer/subscription keys resolve
prior month MRR + SUM(current month mrr_delta_usd) = current month MRR
avg_ttm_arr requires 12 consecutive monthly ARR values
